title: Improve audit to Queue CSV rerun handoff
summary: Reports/Audit export now returns backend handoff metadata and opens Queue > CSV Rerun with the exported CSV selected and previewed through /api/rerun/preview.
reason: CSV rerun is an audit-remediation queue builder. Audit should materialize the CSV, then hand the operator to Queue for preview, scoping, and execution without converting audit rows into normal pipeline queue rows.
behavior_before: Reports/Audit exposed a rerun CSV export action, but the operator had to manually move to the rerun surface and select/preview the generated CSV. The backend export response did not include explicit Queue handoff metadata.
behavior_after: Reports/Audit exposes a Build CSV Rerun Queue action. The backend export response includes the exported CSV path, row count, issue/bucket summaries, and Queue handoff metadata. The WebView navigates to Queue > CSV Rerun, selects the CSV path, and requests backend preview through /api/rerun/preview; CSV rerun start remains /api/rerun/start and /api/pipeline/start is not used.
rollback_plan: Revert the audit export handoff metadata, Reports handoff action/wiring, Queue CSV path selection helper, route/docs inventory updates, generated summaries, and targeted tests. Existing /api/audit/export-rerun-csv and /api/rerun/* backend behavior would remain available but without automatic Reports-to-Queue selection/preview.
